name: Google Gemini API
summary: Google's Gemini API lets your app call Google's AI models to generate text, understand images, and power AI features.

free_plan_covers.note: A free rate-limited tier exists, but Google's docs do not publish an exact requests-per-day number, only that it varies by model and usage tier.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No flat monthly plan; once billing is enabled you pay per token, with rate limits rising by cumulative spend tier.

portability.note: Gemini offers an official OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so code written for the OpenAI SDK can switch with just a base URL and key change.

free_tier.note: Free, rate-limited tier confirmed by Google's own pricing page, usable without payment; Google may use free-tier input to improve products.

sdk_typescript.note: Official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK is published as the "@google/genai" npm package.

cheap_model_price.value: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite: $0.10 input / $0.40 output per million tokens
cheap_model_price.note: Cheapest current general-purpose text model; the newer 3.5 Flash-Lite costs more, at $0.30 input / $2.50 output.

setup.step: Create a free API key in Google AI Studio.
Install the SDK with npm install @google/genai.
Set the key as an environment variable.
Call the client from a server route so the key is never exposed to the browser.
Link a Cloud Billing account once usage needs to exceed the free tier's rate limits.

builder_notes: Keep GEMINI_API_KEY on the server only.
On the free tier, avoid sending sensitive user data since Google may use those inputs to improve its products.
Gemini has an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, useful if you are porting existing OpenAI SDK code.
